verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents first-party ingestion paths: the Data Transfer Service for scheduled load jobs and batch transfers, near-real-time database replication, Pub/Sub BigQuery subscriptions, and a hands-on-tested Sheets connector. However, the evidence never names a catalog of SaaS-app connectors or partner ETL/ELT integrations, and one community user needed a third-party service to move CloudSQL data into BigQuery. Missing for 10: documented SaaS-app connector coverage, a partner ETL/ELT connector ecosystem, per-source setup documentation, and independent corroboration of database connector breadth.
